notes: New Edit menu between File and View: Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, Select All, Select All of a Kind, Deselect All
Click an object to select it, Ctrl+click to select several, Ctrl+A to select everything on the sheet; Delete removes them all in one step
Copy and paste objects, cables, areas and walls on the same sheet or onto another sheet
Drag a selected item to move the whole selection; Shift+drag draws a box to select (Ctrl+Shift+drag adds)
